description: Cross-platform video converter with FFmpeg backend - triple implementation (Swift/macOS + Python + C#/Windows)

main_files.purpose: Main SwiftUI interface with tabs (Principal, Opções, Log, Info)
FFmpeg wrapper, conversion and metadata extraction logic

python_implementation.purpose: Alternative Python GUI implementation using CustomTkinter

main_files.purpose: Main WPF window with 4-tab interface (Principal, Opções, Log, Info)
Code-behind with drag-drop and dialog event handlers
MVVM ViewModel with all properties, commands, and async conversion logic
FFmpeg process management, progress parsing, Windows font resolution
Metadata extraction via regex-based FFmpeg output parsing
Data models: ConversionSettings, VideoMetadata, StreamInfo, ColorSpaceInfo

swift.flow: ContentView.handleDrop() → validateFile() → convert() async → parseProgress() → onProgress callback
swift.ffmpeg_path_resolution: findFFmpeg() searches bundle, then system paths
swift.progress_calculation: parse Duration from FFmpeg output, then currentTime/duration

python.progress_calculation: Parse Duration from 'Duration:' line, calculate from current_time/duration

csharp.flow: MainViewModel.ConvertAsync() → FfmpegService.Convert() → Process with async events → IProgress<double> callback
csharp.ffmpeg_path_resolution: FindFfmpeg() searches bundled ./ffmpeg/, %LOCALAPPDATA%, Program Files, system PATH
csharp.progress_calculation: Regex-based from stdout/stderr output, same pattern as Swift/Python

shared.codec_mapping: libx264 → libx265 → prores_ks → dnxhd → vp9 → mpeg4
shared.audio_codecs: copy → aac → mp3 → opus → vorbis → flac → pcm

swift.flow: ContentView.fetchMetadata() → VideoConverter.extractMetadata() → parse FFmpeg stderr output

python.parsing_method: Regex-based from stderr (same patterns as Swift and C#)

csharp.parsing_method: Regex-based from stderr (same patterns as Swift)

file_input.method: Drag-and-drop via SwiftUI .onDrop() or file picker button

output_flow.method: User selects output path via NSSavePanel / SaveFileDialog / tkFileDialog
output_flow.default_behavior: If not selected, generate timestamped filename in Downloads folder

known_issues.issue: Font file not found on some macOS versions
Font file not found on some Windows versions
known_issues.affected: C# timecode overlay (multiple fallback paths configured)
known_issues.note: Falls back to empty fontfile parameter if no Windows font found

files.purpose: 3-branch sync guide: file mapping, change procedures, platform parity rules
Full project structure, conventions, workflow, troubleshooting

build_commands.csharp_publish: dotnet publish windows/THN-Converter-Win.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true

sync_requirement: When modifying conversion logic, all implementations (Swift, Python, C#) must be updated to maintain feature parity
